title: tradeframe
summary: MSUI implements the current two-sided TradeFrame: exact 384x512 two-portrait shell, six 44-pitch offer rows plus the separated seventh enchant/non-traded row, proposed-enchant green spell text, stock empty-slot/name/enchant art, names, stack counts, both-side item tooltips, three-denomination editable own money, right-anchored coin-art partner money, two-piece accept glows, click-to-place/clear, accept/unaccept/cancel verbs, corrected terminal status handling, and MPQ-authored refusal feedback. TradeFrameUiLaw owns the money-input seats, denomination composition, coin geometry/UVs, accept-glow slice geometry/UVs and stack-count inset as well as all window seats; GameLoop.Trade contains no local Vector2 geometry. Current Benilla auto-answers BEGIN_TRADE with CMSG_BEGIN_TRADE and waits for OPEN_WINDOW; MSUI does the same, and the former custom incoming-trade ImGui prompt and its unused geometry law remain removed. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Slot 7 is drawn identically to slots 1-6: the ref separates the 7th 'Will not be traded' slot with its own label/highlight region
openItems.resolution: TradeFrameUiLaw fixes rows 1-6 at y=104..324 and separates slot 7 at y=389 with the stock enchant overlay, 'Will Be Enchanted' heading, and 'Will Not Be Traded' filled-slot label. A nonzero extended enchant spell replaces that label with the resolved green spell name.

openItems.text: Stack counts are not rendered on trade-slot icons
openItems.resolution: DrawTradeSlot paints NumberFontNormal stack quantities at the item button's bottom-right whenever Count > 1.

openItems.text: No un-accept path: after clicking Trade the button disables; the ref lets the player retract (CMSG_UNACCEPT_TRADE) - MSUI only resets accept on an item/gold change
openItems.resolution: The Cancel action is law-dispatched: when our accept stands it sends CMSG_UNACCEPT_TRADE and keeps the session open; otherwise it sends CMSG_CANCEL_TRADE and closes.

openItems.text: No item tooltips on trade slots (GetTradePlayerItem/GetTradeTargetItem tooltip)
openItems.resolution: Hovering either side's populated item button offers the shared prepared item tooltip with count and durability state.

openItems.text: No partner portrait on the window ring; partner-accept is a text line rather than the ref's highlight glow over the partner column
openItems.resolution: Both player and partner live portraits are drawn below the shell apertures, and each accept flag paints the exact 161x266 column plus 161x61 enchant highlight slices.

openItems.text: TradeFrame rendered the player's offer as one generic integer field and the recipient's offer as a plain formatted string in the wrong seat instead of the authored gold/silver/copper edit boxes and right-anchored NumberFontNormal coin frames.
openItems.resolution: TradeFrameUiLaw now owns the exact three player denomination boxes and coin seats, recipient right anchor, denomination composition/splitting, coin size and atlas UVs. GameLoop.Trade consumes those laws while preserving the existing CMSG_SET_TRADE_GOLD path; focused and full desktop clinical suites pass.
